title: Hey Mom…
subtitle: Recipes and stories from 28 years of feeding the people I love.
author: Missy
intro:
My name is Missy Delaria. I met my husband in 1989, when we were college sweethearts, and in 1995 we married in Wayzata, Minnesota. We bought a wonderful little house in Deep Haven and began building a life of our own. In August of 1997 we welcomed our first child, Kendall, and in September of 1999 we completed our family with our twins, Stockton and Larkin — and just like that, we were a family of five.

When the children arrived, we had a decision to make: would I keep working, or stay home? We chose for me to stay home, and I have been devoted to that choice ever since. For twenty-eight years, my work has been raising our children and feeding our family — putting nutritious, wonderful-tasting, fun food on the table every single day. Food became the center of our home: the everyday dinners, the lunches and after-school snacks, the holidays, the parties, and all the friends and family who gathered around our table along the way.

This book is everything I learned in those twenty-eight years of feeding the people I love. It's the recipes my kids grew up on, the shortcuts that made good food easier, the dishes that fed a crowd, and the sweets that showed up at every celebration. More than anything, it's an invitation. I want to welcome you into my years of experience at the stove — and I hope, in some small way, it helps with yours.

section_blurbs.Let's Make It Easy: Shortcuts, swaps, and smart little tricks for putting genuinely good food on the table without the fuss.
section_blurbs.Family Favorites: The dishes my kids grew up on — the ones they still call home asking me to make.
section_blurbs.Weeknight Yummy: Fast, real dinners for busy nights — the everyday meals that became our everyday.
section_blurbs.Holidays — Always Ready for a Party: Seasonal showstoppers and the traditions that mark our year, ready whenever company comes.
section_blurbs.Desserts: Treats, bakes, and sweets — the ones that made it to every classroom party, bake sale, and birthday.
section_blurbs.Party All the Way Till You Drop: Feeding a crowd, from the first appetizer to the last entrée. Built to disappear.
